item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your day is stacked with check-ins on your own thinking — a morning perspective practice, a question about whether each moment fits the life you're building, and a prompt on projecting or mind-reading later on. That's a lot of self-monitoring in one day, which is good, but it can tip into overthinking if you're not careful. Action: pick one of those check-ins, do it fully, and let the rest be background noise.
